plugins.name: marcora
plugins.description: The context layer for GTM teams. Bundles the hosted Marcora MCP server (OAuth or API token) with its companion skill — marcora-mcp (object model, the core content workflows, the content plans board and playbooks, and reusable multi-step workflows) — so your AI assistant can create on-brand marketing content, manage brand context and blueprints, plan and produce content, and automate recurring marketing work.
